'''Barababaraba''' (Baraba-Baraba), or '''Baraparapa''', is an extinct [[Indigenous Australian language]] once spoken along the southern tributaries of the [[Murrumbidgee River]], [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] and [[New South Wales]]. It was a dialect of [[Wemba-Wemba language|Wemba–Wemba]].<ref name="AIATSIS"/>
